financials_multi_year.source: Ma'aden Q3/9M 2026 Earnings Release (09-Nov-26, SAR/USD 3.75 peg), read 21-Nov-26

observations.revenue: 9M26 revenue SAR 30.87bn ($8.23bn, +10.5% YoY); Q3 revenue SAR 11.1bn ($2.96bn, +11% YoY).
observations.ebitda: Q3 EBITDA SAR 3.3bn ($0.88bn, -24% YoY) on elevated sulfur raw material costs and phosphate logistics; Net Debt/EBITDA ~1.4x.

verdict.summary: Flagship Saudi mining national champion (64-65% PIF-owned, Moody's Baa1 / Fitch BBB+ Stable, SCP bbb-). Moderate 1.4x net leverage at 3Q26, though Q3 2026 EBITDA fell 24% YoY to SAR 3.3bn ($880m) on sulfur input costs and phosphate logistics while major Phosphate 3 & 4 expansion capex continues.

positives: Strong sovereign-parent backing: ~64-65% PIF ownership supports Baa1 / BBB+ ratings (Fitch reaffirmed BBB+ Stable in mid-2026).
Moderate leverage (~1.4x Net Debt/EBITDA at 3Q26 vs 1.5x FY25 and 1.8x FY24) alongside access to $1bn international syndicated loan/RCF and sukuk markets.
Diversified commodity mix across phosphate fertilizers, aluminium, and gold.
negatives: Q3 2026 margin squeeze: Q3 EBITDA fell 24% YoY to SAR 3.3bn ($880m) and net profit -24% to SAR 1.68bn on sulfur costs and logistics.
Heavy Vision 2030 mining expansion capex (Phosphate 3 & 4) can absorb FCF during commodity troughs.
Cyclical exposure to global DAP/MAP fertilizer and aluminium prices.

background.business_overview: Saudi Arabia's national mining & metals champion operating integrated phosphate, aluminium, and gold/base-metals complexes.
background.asset_perimeter: Wa'ad Al Shamal & Ras Al Khair phosphate/aluminium JVs plus Saudi gold mines.
background.ownership_governance: ~64-65% owned by Public Investment Fund (PIF); listed on Tadawul.

recent_drivers: 09-Nov-26 (Q3/9M 2026): Q3 rev SAR 11.1bn (+11% YoY), Q3 EBITDA SAR 3.3bn (-24% YoY), 9M rev SAR 30.87bn (+10.5% YoY), net leverage ~1.4x.
Mid-2026: Fitch reaffirmed BBB+ Stable (SCP bbb-); closed $1bn inaugural international term loan & RCF.
